svg.text: GPU Utilization Management: class diagram of package gpu.model
- Job refers to its Student by the studentId text field (not an object link), so the Scheduler looks the student up by ID.
- Queue position, predicted start and wait are not stored in Job; they are calculated from the records and the simulation clock.
- All time values are LocalDateTime from the simulation clock; TimeFormat gives dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm for display and saving.
